clue.text: Mean girl given ring by boy

parts.note: Bet is a short form of the girl's name Elizabeth
a ring is round, like the letter O
Ken is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A spiteful girl receives a ring from her boyfriend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mean' looks like an adjective describing the girl, but it is the definition, used as a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To betoken something is to signify or indicate it, a synonym of the verb mean.

clue.text: Go round and reportedly fork out for permit

indicators.note: reportedly means the phrase is heard, so its sound gives the letters

parts.note: to fork out for a permit is to buy a pass

explanation.surface: Avoid a charge and pay for a licence, so they say.
explanation.definitionFit: To bypass something is to go round it instead of through.

clue.text: Journalist finally in a rush to produce copy?

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of the word journalist

parts.note: racing means hurrying, in a rush

explanation.surface: A reporter at last hurries to file a story.
explanation.definitionFit: A tracing is a copy of a drawing made through thin paper.

clue.text: More eager, longing to replace first European cooker

indicators.note: to replace means the longing word takes the place of the European letter

parts.note: keener means more eager

indicators.note: first picks the opening letter of the word European, the letter that is swapped out

parts.note: an itch is a longing or craving

explanation.surface: A keener desire takes over from a European cooking range.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to replace' swaps ITCH for the first E of KEENER, giving K-ITCH-ENER.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchener is an old kitchen range, a cooking stove.

clue.text: Drink thrown up by hotel close at hand

indicators.note: thrown up means the word is turned upside down in a down entry, read backwards

parts.note: gin is a drink
H is hotel in the phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A drink is vomited up near the hotel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thrown up' turns GIN into NIG.
explanation.definitionFit: Nigh means near, close at hand.

clue.text: Smothering resistance, recklessly pays up for ancient document

indicators.note: smothering means the anagrammed letters close over the resistance symbol
done recklessly, the letters of pays up are thrown into a new order

parts.note: R is the physics symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: Someone stops resisting and pays out carelessly for an old manuscript.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recklessly' turns PAYS UP into PAPYUS, and 'Smothering' puts R inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Papyrus is the reed paper of ancient Egypt, and a scroll written on it is an ancient document.

clue.text: Writing mostly about one's antibiotic

indicators.note: about means the trimmed word goes round the numeral
mostly means the last letter of the writing word is dropped

parts.note: pencilling is writing in pencil
one is I in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Most of the writing concerns someone's antibiotic prescription.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' drops the final G; 'about' puts the Roman one inside, after the first three letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Penicillin was the first antibiotic widely used against bacterial infection.

clue.text: Part of stock maybe supplied by papa and others?

parts.note: P is papa in the phonetic alphabet
et al is Latin for and others

explanation.surface: Part of the store, perhaps, provided by Dad and others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stock' looks like goods, but it is the garden flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Stock is a scented garden flower, and a petal is one part of its bloom.

clue.text: Composer and Arctic explorer in one

parts.note: James Clark Ross explored the Arctic and Antarctic
one is I in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A musician and polar explorer combined in one person.
explanation.definitionFit: Gioachino Rossini was the Italian who wrote The Barber of Seville.

clue.text: Nurse got ruffled? Something fishy here

indicators.note: ruffled means the letters of nurse got are disturbed and rearranged

explanation.surface: A nurse was flustered; something suspicious is going on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fishy' seems to mean suspicious, but it is literal: the definition points to a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The sturgeon is a large fish, prized for caviar.

clue.text: Devise principle inspiring a key royal dynasty

parts.note: to devise is to plan

indicators.note: inspiring, in its sense of breathing in, means the principle takes the other letters inside it

parts.note: a tenet is a principle or belief
G is a musical key

explanation.surface: Coming up with a core idea that inspires a key ruling family.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inspiring' puts A G inside TENET to give TAGENET.
explanation.definitionFit: The Plantagenets were the English royal house from Henry II to Richard III.

clue.text: Old coin identified by woman on radio

indicators.note: heard on the radio, the name is only heard, so its sound gives the letters

parts.note: Sue is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A rare coin is identified by a woman broadcasting on the radio.
explanation.definitionFit: The sou was a French coin of small value, no longer in use.

clue.text: Minor initially lacking in vision

indicators.note: in places that letter within the word for vision

parts.note: vision is the faculty of sight

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of the word lacking

explanation.surface: A child at first has poor eyesight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Minor' looks like a young person, but it is the definition as an adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Something slight is small or unimportant, a synonym of minor.

clue.text: Produce notes about indifferent lecture

indicators.note: about means the singing word goes round the other one

parts.note: to sing is to produce musical notes
cold can mean indifferent or unfeeling

explanation.surface: Write a few jottings on a dull lecture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Produce notes' suggests writing, but it means singing.
explanation.definitionFit: A scolding is a stern telling-off, as is a lecture in its reproving sense.

clue.text: Crazy, Gershwin accepting allotment by lake

indicators.note: accepting means the lyricist's name takes the allotment inside it

parts.note: Ira Gershwin wrote lyrics for his brother George
a ration is an allotted share

explanation.surface: Mad Gershwin takes on a garden plot beside a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'allotment' looks like a British garden plot, but here it means a share.
explanation.definitionFit: Irrational means not guided by reason, so crazy.

clue.text: Supreme commander lives with short man by common

parts.note: general means common or widespread
lives means exists, so is

indicators.note: short means the man's name loses its last letter

parts.note: Simon is a man's name

explanation.surface: A top commander lives alongside a small man near the village green.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' drops the man's last letter. 'common' looks like a village green but means general, as in widespread.
explanation.definitionFit: A generalissimo is the commander-in-chief of all the armed forces, the supreme military leader.

clue.text: Vandalised city's plea for discipline

indicators.note: vandalised means the letters of city's plea are smashed up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A wrecked town calls for law and order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'discipline' looks like punishment, but it means a field of study.
explanation.definitionFit: A specialty is a field of expertise, and a discipline is a branch of knowledge.

clue.text: Ant-bear's way to board a Bible rescue boat

indicators.note: to board means the road abbreviation gets on, going inside the letters that follow

parts.note: AV is the Authorised Version of the Bible
Rd is the abbreviation for road, a way
Noah's ark rescued the animals from the flood

explanation.surface: An animal makes its way onto a Bible boat that saved creatures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to board' puts the road abbreviation inside the first two pieces, between the two As and the V.
explanation.definitionFit: Ant-bear is another name for the aardvark, an African ant-eating mammal.

clue.text: Adapt without guile, given time inside otherwise

parts.note: to adapt something is to alter it

indicators.note: inside means the time letter goes within the word for guileless

parts.note: naively means innocently, without guile

explanation.surface: Change your ways, dropping deceit, given time, or else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside' puts T into NAIVELY to give NATIVELY.
explanation.definitionFit: Alternatively and otherwise both introduce a second option, used as synonyms.

clue.text: Barrow corporation bully regularly going to America

parts.note: corporation is old slang for a paunch, a tum

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter of the word bully

parts.note: US is America

explanation.surface: A town council in Barrow intimidates people on its way to America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Barrow' looks like the Cumbrian town of Barrow-in-Furness, but it is an ancient burial mound.
explanation.definitionFit: A tumulus is an ancient burial mound, also called a barrow.

clue.text: Former partisan's uniform stolen from the solver's chest

indicators.note: stolen from means that letter is taken away from the words that follow

parts.note: the solver is you, so the solver's is your
U is uniform in the phonetic alphabet
kist is a Scottish word for a chest

explanation.surface: An old partisan's uniform has been stolen from your trunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stolen from' takes U out of YOUR, leaving YOR.
explanation.definitionFit: Yorkists backed the House of York in the Wars of the Roses, partisans of the past.

clue.text: Old queen keeping horse and wild ass

indicators.note: keeping means the old queen holds the horse inside

parts.note: ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, queen
a nag is a horse

explanation.surface: An elderly queen kept a horse and a donkey.
explanation.definitionFit: The onager is a wild ass of Asia.

clue.text: Servant's argument at home?

definitions.meaning: a household servant such as a maid
a row between partners or family members

explanation.surface: A household servant quarrels inside the house.
explanation.definitionFit: A domestic is a house servant, and also a family row reported by police.

clue.text: Peter Rabbit's head is more secure

parts.note: peter is old criminal slang for a safe

indicators.note: head picks the first letter of the word rabbit

explanation.surface: Beatrix Potter's rabbit's head is better protected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Peter Rabbit' reads as the storybook bunny; Peter is the safe.
explanation.definitionFit: Safer is the comparative of safe, meaning better protected.

clue.text: Fruit and wine consumed by two-thirds of withered old women

indicators.note: consumed by means the wine goes inside the trimmed word
two-thirds of means only four of the six letters are kept, the last two dropped

parts.note: crones are withered old women
It is Italian vermouth, as in gin and it

explanation.surface: Fruit and wine are swallowed by most of a group of old women.
explanation.walkthrough: 'two-thirds of' keeps four of the six letters; 'consumed by' puts the Italian vermouth inside. 'It' as wine comes from the drink gin and it.
explanation.definitionFit: A citron is a large lemon-like citrus fruit.

clue.text: Mr Fawlty familiarly adopting a South African title

indicators.note: adopting means the short name takes the letter a inside it

parts.note: Basil Fawlty of the British sitcom Fawlty Towers, shortened familiarly to Bas

explanation.surface: Basil Fawlty informally takes a South African form of address.
explanation.definitionFit: Baas is Afrikaans for boss or master, used as a title of address.

clue.text: Be sick, spitting out fermented beer?

indicators.note: spitting out the word means saying it, so its sound gives the letters

parts.note: ale is a beer made by fermentation

explanation.surface: Feeling ill and spitting out a bad beer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spitting out' looks like a deletion signal, but here it means speaking.
explanation.definitionFit: To ail is to be unwell, an old-fashioned synonym of being sick.

clue.text: Aficionado jumping over arched structure

parts.note: an aficionado is a fan
vaulting is jumping over something

explanation.surface: An enthusiast leaps over an arch.
explanation.definitionFit: Fan vaulting is a Gothic ceiling of fan-shaped ribbed vaults, an arched structure.

clue.text: Raptor's way to get into vessel crossing river

indicators.note: to get into means the street abbreviation goes inside the rest
crossing means the vessel spans over the river letter, which sits inside it

parts.note: keel stands for a ship, by its part for the whole
St is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: A bird of prey's route takes it into a boat crossing a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to get into' and 'crossing' both put letters inside KEEL, giving KE-STR-EL; 'vessel' means a ship here, named by its keel.
explanation.definitionFit: The kestrel is a small falcon, a bird of prey.

clue.text: Unscrupulous lawyer invested in trashy stereo

indicators.note: invested in means the answer is clothed in the letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A crooked lawyer put money into a cheap hi-fi.
explanation.definitionFit: Shyster is American slang for a dishonest lawyer.
